blocks.text: Entitlements refer to the type of access privileges and permissions that are assigned to Authentication Service users and user groups. Authentication Service supports Administrative and Service entitlements.

The Administrative entitlements are used to assign and manage Authentication Service users and user group's administrative access to a Zscaler service (e.g., Internet & SaaS (ZIA), Private Access (ZPA)) with the specific role that is created in the respective Zscaler service.
To provide users or user groups administrative access and assign a role:

blocks.item: Add roles on the respective service in the Zscaler Admin Console. To add roles for:
Authentication Service, see Adding Authentication Service Admin Roles.
Internet & SaaS, see Adding Admin Roles.
Private Access, see Configuring Administrator Roles.
Digital Experience Monitoring (ZDX), see Adding ZDX Roles.
Zscaler Client Connector, see Adding Roles.
Zscaler Cloud & Branch Connector, see Adding Admin Roles.
Deception, see About Users & Roles.
Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), see About Access Roles.
Business Insights, see About Administrators in Business Insights.
Risk360, see Adding Admin Roles.
Authentication Service supports login to Zscaler Breach Predictor through Risk360, even if the Risk360 or Breach Predictor tenants have not been migrated to Authentication Service.
Workflow Automation, see Managing Admin Assignments.
Breach Predictor, see Using Breach Predictor.
EASM, see About Role Management.
Zero Trust Branch, see Understanding Zero Trust Branch Access Roles.
Management Portal for Partners, see About Roles in the Management Portal for Partners.

Zscaler Cellular, the Cellular Edge service must be enabled for your organization. To enable Cellular Edge, your organization must have Internet & SaaS, Private Access, and Branch Connector services enabled. Cellular Edge is not supported if your organization has more than one of either Internet & SaaS or Private Access services. To learn more, contact your Zscaler Account team.

The roles on the respective service are automatically synced into Authentication Service at regular intervals. To ensure that your Authentication Service database is up to date, you can perform a manual sync from the View Roles page. See image.
Add users and user groups in the Zscaler Admin Console.
From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Role Management > Administrative Entitlements.
On the Administrative Entitlements page, select the service for which you want to assign users or user groups with admin roles.
See image.
On the Users or User Groups tab, click Assign Users or Assign Groups to create a new administrative entitlement. You can also edit or delete the entitlements, if required.
See image.
Assign users or user groups with admin roles to the service.
See image.
(Optional) View the list of assigned users and user groups as service admins.
(Optional) Manage the list of devices a user can use to access Zscaler services.

blocks.text: If a user is assigned to multiple user groups with different levels of access, then the group assigned first takes precedence, and the user can perform tasks according to the role assigned to that group. However, if a user is assigned to a service admin role individually, and they are also a part of a user group with a different admin role, then the role assigned to the individual user takes precedence over the user group role.
The Service entitlements are used for assigning Authentication Service users and user groups to a Zscaler service (e.g., Internet & SaaS, Private Access).
To assign users or user groups to a Zscaler service:

blocks.item: Add users and user groups in the Zscaler Admin Console.
Go to Administration > Subscription > End User Entitlements.
See image.
On the Service Entitlements page, select the service for which you want to assign users or user groups.
Assign users or user groups to the service.
See image.
(Optional) View the list of users and user groups assigned to the service.
(Optional) Manage the list of devices a user can use to access Zscaler services.
